newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Moslems probe cheeky schoolgirls.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Moslems probe cheeky schoolgirls.

text.p: State religious officers in Malaysia's northern Perak state are investigating a report that schoolgirls are offering their cheeks to be caressed for 20 cents (US$0.08), a local newspaper reported on Thursday.

"We have received a report from a person in Taiping of the existence of such girls but we have yet to determine in which school they are studying," State Religious Affairs Department enforcement chief Haji Ismail Mokhtar was quoted by The Star daily as saying.
The report said that the amount charged by the secondary schoolgirls would increase by a few cents if the "client" preferred to touch other parts of their faces.
Islam is Malaysia's state religion, and the country observes religious sharia laws even though its government is secular. Over half of its 20 million population is Moslem.
